summary:
StreamReadConstraints.maxDocumentLength was not enforced for fixed-buffer and
DataInput input. The document-length limit was added in 2.16.0 (f511bcd0, #1101),
on top of StreamReadConstraints, which was added in 2.15.0. At tag
jackson-core-2.14.0-rc2 there is no StreamReadConstraints class and no
validateDocumentLength / maxDocumentLength anywhere under src/, so there is no
limit to bypass. Upstream lists the 2.x range as >= 2.16.0, < 2.18.7 and
>= 2.19.0, < 2.21.2.
